svg.text: Fuse: the agent proposes, the chip decides, the chain remembers
ed25519 key - never leaves the chip
exactly one key: a function-call key
parks big payments for a second chip
allow / warn / block for any account
the same chip signs for Sepolia and Bitcoin
verifies the payment on the chain,
402 with a price, then retry with the tx hash
Three locks enforce one budget: the function-call key (protocol), the firmware (silicon), the contract (onchain). Any one failing still bounds the loss.
